description: This Java class defines a theme configuration for a preview popup in an Android keyboard application, including style attributes and animation types.

classes.name: PreviewPopupTheme
classes.description: A class encapsulating style and animation settings for a preview popup in the keyboard app.

methods.name: getPreviewKeyTextSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the preview key text.

methods.name: setPreviewKeyTextSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the preview key text.

methods.name: getPreviewLabelTextSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the preview label text, defaulting to key text size if not set.

methods.name: setPreviewLabelTextSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the preview label text.

methods.name: getPreviewKeyBackground
methods.description: Returns the background drawable for the preview key.

methods.name: setPreviewKeyBackground
methods.description: Sets the background drawable for the preview key.

methods.name: getPreviewKeyTextColor
methods.description: Returns the text color for the preview key.

methods.name: setPreviewKeyTextColor
methods.description: Sets the text color for the preview key.

methods.name: getKeyStyle
methods.description: Returns the Typeface style for the key.

methods.name: setKeyStyle
methods.description: Sets the Typeface style for the key.

methods.name: getVerticalOffset
methods.description: Returns the vertical offset for the preview popup.

methods.name: setVerticalOffset
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset for the preview popup.

methods.name: getPreviewAnimationType
methods.description: Returns the current animation style type for the preview popup.

methods.name: setPreviewAnimationType
methods.description: Sets the animation style type for the preview popup.
